turns.goal: Now support the snake option on the printer. With snake=true, lay the first row left to right, reverse the second row, and alternate from there, including short rows. The ordinary sheet stays as it was.

turns.goal: The gallery guide plays its default narration even when the requested language exists. Prefer the exact requested tag and use the fallback tag only if it is absent. An empty string is an intentional silent clip.

Some visitors choose a more specific language tag than a gallery recorded. Try the exact tag, then successively remove the last hyphen-separated subtag until a clip is found. Try the supplied fallback last. Silent clips still count.
